subject: [PATCH 2/5] mm/gup: split follow_page_pte_commit() out of follow_page_pte()

2026-08-01.patch_summary: This patch splits the function follow_page_pte() into two separate functions: follow_page_pte_commit() and follow_page_pte(). The new function, follow_page_pte_commit(), handles the per-folio work of grabbing a reference to the page, making it accessible if necessary, marking it dirty or accessed if required, and flushing the cache. This change is intended to prepare for future modifications that will allow committing multiple pages at once. No functional changes are introduced by this patch.
